faq.question: Can an item be reviewed without a hallmark?
faq.answer: Some materials can still be checked. Confirmation may take longer depending on condition.

faq.question: Can damaged jewellery be discussed?
faq.answer: Broken chains and single earrings may be reviewed when the material can be confirmed.

faq.question: Do gemstones affect the appraisal?
faq.answer: The approach varies by item. Official appraisal rules will be connected later.

faq.question: Can overseas or branded products be discussed?
faq.answer: Material and condition are checked individually. Brand-value handling awaits final operating rules.

faq.question: Can every condition be reviewed?
faq.answer: Items that can be handled safely may be discussed; legal or storage restrictions can apply.
